The supplied history line bfaabe1d2275353daa3f15ef64b1c4afd3af7a05 ("fix(crq-python): Tighten validators, pin diff format, bound git, unlock collect-history") is the commit that applied this hardening. All asserted bypasses (SHA/target trailing newline, digest double-acceptance in normalize_observation, TS_RE `\d`) are closed by the current code.
